records.assumption: Shared linear/norm/embedding/head arithmetic cancels. All learned frequencies are differentiated; the shared retained-E8 attention has zero sink and fixed temperature, as in canonical v1. Static counts include every v1 scan trip; compiler estimates are separate. The selected candidate loses D/2 frequency parameters per layer, so any identical elementwise optimizer costs no more. Optional projected variants separately charge three learned margin/gain controls per head.
records.affine_justification: Every shape is batch-independent or B times a constant, no product contracts two independent batch axes, and all scan lengths and Python branches are batch-independent. Pointwise counts are linear; reductions across B cost B-1 per fixed group; other reductions are linear. Thus the complete source-program count is affine in B>=1. B=3 is an additional regression crosscheck. Shared optimizer arithmetic is non-increasing with the smaller parameter count. No extra rematerialization, sparsity or data-dependent loop is assumed.

cost_convention: Integer source-program counts: scalar arithmetic/division each 1, matrix products 2*M*N*K, roots separate, every scan trip included. Min/max, comparisons and selects are also reported separately and can be included conservatively. CPU XLA lowered/compiled estimates are additional evidence; their rsqrt appears in a bucket named transcendentals. HLO scanner independently rejects forbidden mathematical operations.
limitation: Compiler-specific theoretical estimates, not a mathematical proof of TPU compiler arithmetic or latency. V2 positions are unrolled completely; positive-length v1 scan bodies are costed at least once, so their underestimated trip counts make the comparison harder for v2.
